summary: Jayud Global Logistics filed a Form 6-K furnishing interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, its US-equivalent half-year earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer. Revenue rose about RMB140.4 million, or 50.0%, to roughly RMB421.0 million (US$61.8 million), while cost of revenue climbed 62.8% to RMB425.0 million, outpacing top-line growth. No transaction, stakeholder, or board action is disclosed. The exhibit is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf. Watch margin compression and freight-cost inflation, not deal terms.
